notes_for_editor: No build year appears in any source read. The 1950s Northwest Angle article describes an 80-foot fire lookout at a lumber camp but does not name the Warroad tower, so linking that tower to the 1951 Northwest Angle lookout is an inference. The article credits ownership to the State Department of Conservation; the county list says Minnesota Forest Service. The Northwest Angle tower's removal date is not given. No photos. Two web searches used.
